'''Morphanessa''' is a [[Water]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Waveflutter]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Morphanessa's wings call forth the soothing rain that cleanses all things, washing away the unpleasant dirt and grit so the world is as clear as a mirror. All that remains shall be a perfect reflection of that lovely shade of red."

Waveflutter is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.

== Trivia ==
* Morphanessa was added to the game on 9/8/2026 alongside [[Ringtail]] and [[Blechlama]].
